patch.summary: Manchester strength and powerlifting gym offering memberships, drop-in access and personal training, with round-the-clock member access.
patch.description:
Free State Barbell Club operates a strength-focused gym in Manchester with competition-style lifting equipment. Its website welcomes beginners as well as experienced lifters.

Memberships, drop-in passes and a personal-training option are listed on the business website. Arrange a trial visit or ask about current access requirements directly; 24-hour member access is not a promise of staffed reception or unrestricted walk-in entry.

The gym also describes shared training times. This business listing does not establish a separate community group or publish member identities. Check current services, terms and availability with the business.
patch.accessInstructions: Use the main website for membership, drop-in, trial-visit and contact information. Membership signup is handled by the gym's external provider, linked under Additional resources. Contact the business before an initial visit and check event-related closures. Admission depends on the gym's current terms; the directory does not take bookings or collect membership details.
patch.openingHours: 24/7 member access. The published FAQ notes closures during two annual powerlifting meets; confirm dates and first-visit arrangements directly.
